{{Quote|I'll take all the plates to the Central Computer and ask it which one is the red one.|C-3PO, to R2-D2|<ref name="AICS" />}}
The '''Central Computer''' was an artificial intelligence module that was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the later stages of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was located in a [[Unidentified Rebel base (Central Computer)|certain base]] in which [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] stayed at some point following the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Excuse me, Central Computer, but could you tell me if that plate is ''red''?|C-3PO|<ref name="AICS" />}}
At some point following its [[Battle of Endor/Legends|victory]] at [[Endor/Legends|Endor]],<ref name="Date">In ''[[Star Wars Adventures in Colors and Shapes]]'', the Central Computer contains data about the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]]. However, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] first encountered that [[Species/Legends|species]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which was depicted in {{Film|VI}}.</ref> the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] established a [[Unidentified Rebel base (Central Computer)|new base]]. Those headquarters notably hosted the Central Computer, an artificial intelligence module with an extensive database. During a sojourn at the base, the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] consulted the Central Computer to help him identify the [[Color/Legends|color]] of a [[fulstar plate]].<ref name="AICS" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:Central_Computer_Hoojib.png|thumb|left|200px|The screen of the Central Computer]]
{{Quote|This plate is ''brown'' like this Ewok or a piece of wood or a Wookiee.|The Central Computer, to C-3PO|<ref name="AICS" />}}
The Central Computer functioned as a talking database. Its light grey shell casing had a blockish appearance. It was equipped with an inclined control panel, a single screen and a camera eye. In those regards, the Central Computer shared many similarities<ref name="AICS" /> with the much bigger [[BRT supercomputer/Legends|BRT supercomputers]].<ref name="TCA">"[[The Constancia Affair]]"</ref> It was [[Programmer/Legends|programmed]] to have a [[Gender/Legends|feminine]] personality and was fitted with a [[Vocabulator/Legends|speech synthesizer]] that allowed it to communicate in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]].<ref name="AICS" />
